transcript.text: Thank you all for flagging these issues. Let me summarize what I'm hearing and then make my decision. Thomas, the exclusive forum clause means we need to file in the state court of the county where the executive worked, not wherever we might otherwise have preferred. Nadia, the forensic evidence only supports copying of the customer-list database -- not pricing materials or source-code documentation -- so seeking broad relief on all three categories would be overreaching. Owen, we need the carrier's written consent before seeking injunctive relief, or we risk losing coverage. Given all three issues, here is my decision: we will authorize the preliminary injunction, but we will file in the state court specified by the separation agreement's exclusive forum clause, we will narrow the injunction scope to customer-list information only to match the forensic evidence, and we will not file until the carrier's written consent has been obtained. I need each of you to update your respective files and materials accordingly. Thomas, please update the strategy memorandum with the forum clause. Nadia, please update the evidence chart to reflect that only the customer-list database was copied. Owen, please initiate the carrier consent request immediately and let me know as soon as it's secured. We will target filing within the three-week window, but only after all three prerequisites are met.
